description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git-http-backend' without a server, focusing on HTTP request handling, request method simulation, and testing path validations.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Executes the git http-backend with specific query string and path, capturing output and error streams.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP GET request to the backend, verifies response status.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP POST request to the backend, verifies response status.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Checks if the backend correctly handles PATH_INFO restrictions, expecting aliasing errors for unsafe paths.
